programme.title: Guillaume's Paris
programme.desc: Guillaume Brahimi bezoekt een chocoladefabriek in het elfde en twaalfde arrondissement van Parijs.

programme.title: Bon Appetit
programme.desc: Rudi Vranckx krijgt eindelijk de rust die hij verdient: Wim en Jeroen trakteren hem op een verdiende vakantie in de Périgord. Rudi waagt zich met Jeroen aan een musketier duel en doopt het dessert van Wim om tot de beste tiramisu ooit.

programme.title: Feest van Eigen Bodem
programme.desc: Bart Desmidt zet voor de feestdagen drie Belgische vleeswaren in de kijker als hapje. Hij kiest voor potjesvlees met mayonaise van waterkers en knolselder, aardappelpannenkoekjes met bloedworst en appel en echte boerenpaté met witloof en broodkruim.

programme.title: Over (h)eerlijke groenten
programme.desc: Johan Segers gaat vandaag op bezoek bij Thomas Cools, teler van Brussels grondwitlof. De chef komt er alles te weten over dit edele product. Daarna maakt hij een bladerdeegbroodje met witlof.

programme.title: Guillaume's Paris
programme.desc: Guillaume geniet van de fijnere kanten van het Parijse leven in het zevende en achtste arrondissement, inclusief een bezoek aan de Eiffeltoren en een maaltijd in het iconische Jules Verne-restaurant.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Sarah en Loïc toveren een kidsproof menu op tafel. Loïc verbergt groenten in zijn tomatensaus en puree en rolt de perfecte ballekes. Sarah gaat voor het lievelingsdessert van haar kinderen: verse donuts. Heerlijk luchtig en verslavend lekker.

programme.title: De Chalet, Hollandse Maatjes
programme.desc: Peppe, Dominique en Roger zetten de eerste dag van hun weekend in met een oranje cocktail, Hollandse maatjes en een lamsstoofpot. En terwijl Roger spritsen bakt met lokale bloem, trekken onze twee macho's naar het strand op een snorfiets.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: In Brecon ontmoet Chris de Nepalese gemeenschap. Hij laat zich inspireren door het koken met kruiden en vuur, en serveert een eerbetoon aan thuis en traditie.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Met Pomme Moscovite - of Pomme Tsarines - als leidraad toveren Bert en Giel twee totaal verschillende luxegerechten op het bord. Altijd afgewerkt met kaviaar en op een bedje van heerlijk gepureerde aardappelen.

programme.title: Ware Delicatessen
programme.desc: Chef Bart Desmidt gaat aan de slag met ingrediënten die als een ware delicatesse worden beschouwd. Met deze ingrediënten maakt hij bijzondere gerechten iedereen zou kunnen maken in beperkte tijd. Deze keer maakt hij gebruik van kaviaar.

programme.title: Guten Appetit
programme.desc: Vandaag is het Elke Vanelderen haar dag. Tijdens een wijnproeverij en bergwandeling praat ze openhartig over de liefde en verlies. Jeroen en Wim verrassen haar ondertussen met haar favoriete en nostalgische, culinaire hoogstandjes.

programme.title: Sarah's Sweet Table
programme.desc: Het oog wil ook wat, dat is zeker zo in de patisserie. Vandaag bakt Sarah twee desserts die er heel leuk uitzien op je koffietafel: een blauwe bessentaart met frangipanevulling en de beroemde rochers die Sarah een gouden laagje geeft.

programme.title: Peppe's Sicilië
programme.desc: Peppe spreekt af met de notaris van Siculiana, Giuseppe Fanara. Een drukbezette man, maar op zijn landgoed Borgo Giallonardo komt hij tot rust. Peppe ook. Daar aangekomen bereidt hij heerlijke artisjok met wilde venkel.

programme.title: Apero - Dining
programme.desc: Jeroen de Pauw en Andy de Brouwer bundelen hun fantasie en serveren kleine gerechten en opmerkelijke dranken voor een eigentijds avondje eetplezier. Andy serveert een eigenzinnige negroni en Jeroen roostert wortelen in koffiegruis.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Als de bomma komt eten, moet alles kloppen. Loïc maakt de ossobuco van zijn mamy Francine, helemaal volgens haar recept. Sarah brengt een dessert vol nostalgie met kruidige peren. Want, niets roept meer nostalgie op dan een portie warm fruit!

programme.title: Toasted!
programme.desc: Dominique Persoone en Dagny Ros maken een spannende Red Alert, Orange Crush en Bloempotbrood.

programme.desc: Bart Desmidt, Peppe Giacomazza, Bert Meewis en Jelle Beeckman halen alles uit de kast voor een feestelijk menu vol smaak, gezelligheid en culinaire inspiratie.

programme.desc: Voor zijn Winterse Kost kleurt Jelle vandaag buiten de lijntjes en gooit twee Vlaamse klassiekers door elkaar. Het resultaat? Varkenswangen in een roomsausje met gestoofde rode kool en krokante patatjes. Smakelijk!

programme.title: Vlaamse Klassiekers
programme.desc: Wie Vlaamse klassiekers zegt, zegt stoofvlees met frietjes. Lynn leert vandaag de kneepjes van het oer-Vlaamse stoofpotje bij Mémé Gusta in Gent. Daarna bezoekt ze brasserie De Zwaan in Hasselt voor haar favoriete stuk vis: kabeljauwhaasje.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: Bourgondiër Bert maakt in de winter al eens graag een goeie, stevige stoemp klaar. Vandaag is dat stoemp met savooikool, spekjes en braadworst. De perfecte Winterse Kost.

programme.title: Peppe's Toscane
programme.desc: Peppe trekt naar San Casciano Val di Pesa, een dorpje enkele kilometers onder Firenze. Daar vindt hij de beste pecorinokaas (schapenkaas) van de regio. Het brein achter de pecorino luistert naar de naam Toni Ballarin.

programme.title: Meat Timon

programme.title: Peppe e Carluccio
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza maakt kennis met de peetvader van de Italiaanse keuken, Antonio Carluccio.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Een boottochtje, een glaasje Kombucha, een kraakverse croissant met sterallures én een workshop keramiek draaien. Dat heeft Gent vandaag in de aanbieding voor de Nederlandse foodies Lynn, Tess en Maud.

programme.desc: Wie Vlaamse klassiekers zegt, zegt stoofvlees met frietjes. Lynn leert vandaag de kneepjes van het oer-Vlaamse stoofpotje bij Mémé Gusta in Gent. Daarna bezoekt ze brasserie De Zwaan in Hasselt voor haar favoriete stuk vis: kabeljauwhaasje.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: Bourgondiër Bert maakt in de winter al eens graag een goeie, stevige stoemp klaar. Vandaag is dat stoemp met savooikool, spekjes en braadworst. De perfecte Winterse Kost.

programme.title: Peppe's Toscane
programme.desc: Peppe trekt naar San Casciano Val di Pesa, een dorpje enkele kilometers onder Firenze. Daar vindt hij de beste pecorinokaas (schapenkaas) van de regio. Het brein achter de pecorino luistert naar de naam Toni Ballarin.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Timon laat zijn beste vouwtechnieken zien voor prijswinnende dumplings gevuld met tartaar van bavette in een kokostomatenjus. Daarna pakt hij uit met quesadilla's in burritostijl met vers varkensgehakt, maïs, rode bonen en frisse aioli.

programme.title: Peppe e Carluccio
programme.desc: Peppe Giacomazza maakt kennis met de peetvader van de Italiaanse keuken, Antonio Carluccio.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Een boottochtje, een glaasje Kombucha, een kraakverse croissant met sterallures én een workshop keramiek draaien. Dat heeft Gent vandaag in de aanbieding voor de Nederlandse foodies Lynn, Tess en Maud.

programme.title: Het Weekmenu
programme.desc: Steffi Vertriest bereidt zalm met bloemkoolcouscous, falafel met vegan mayonaise, ratatouille met zoete aardappel en gevulde courgette.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.sub-title: Het Weekmenu - Winterse Kost van Bert Meewis
programme.desc: Voor Bert is koken in de winter met seizoensgebonden producten puur geluk! Zijn Winterse Kost is deze keer vogelnestjes, romige erwtensoep, gebakken griet met knolselderpuree in witte wijnsaus en een stukje varkensvlees met schorseneren.

programme.title: Sarah's Sweet Table
programme.desc: Vandaag maakt Sarah haar topdessert klaar: verse bokkenpootjes. Ze laat zien hoe die in de patisseriezaak zo krokant én smeuïg gebakken worden. In het weekend zijn pannenkoeken haar go to, zoals haar kruidige versie van de klassieke Crêpe Suzette.

programme.title: Vanavond bij ons
programme.desc: Loïc wil zijn vriendin Ella in de watten leggen met een romantisch tweegangenmenu. Hij kiest voor een klassieke steak au poivre. Sarah zorgt voor een verleidelijk dessert met aardbei en een krokantje. Het perfecte menu voor elke datenight.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Timon pakt uit met twee verrassende vleesgerechten. Hij serveert lams-meatballs met kruidige tomatensaus tussen zelfgebakken broodjes. Daarna bewijst hij met gelakte kalfszwezerik dat ook orgaanvlees een absolute ster op het bord kan zijn.

programme.title: De Garde van Gert
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst en chef Roger Van Damme gaan op uitstap naar Thailand. Maar dan figuurlijk, want ze maken deze keer Thais geïnspireerde loempia's met krab en garnalen. Met liefde gerold.

programme.title: Meat Timon

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Hasseltse jenever, Hasseltse speculaashoempen en verse Hasseltse bloemen van bij de bloemencowboy. Tess, Maud en Lynn stranden vandaag in de Limburgse hoofdstad voor een inspirerende, culinaire ontdekkingstocht.

programme.title: Peppe's Toscane
programme.desc: De hype van het moment in Italië is het biokweken. Ook Carlo Agliardi is met zijn boerderij in San Miniato op die kar gesprongen en nodigt Peppe uit voor een wandeling op het veld. Met zijn oogst maakt hij de typische Toscaanse soep ribollita.

programme.title: De Sterrenkaart

programme.desc: Quyên reist door culinair Vietnam, van noord naar zuid. Deze keer gaat ze naar de zuidelijke stad Hoi An. Onderweg maakt ze kennis met plaatselijke specialiteiten en ingrediënten waarmee ze heerlijke gerechten maakt.

programme.title: Saban
programme.desc: Zesdelige documentaireserie over Hall of Fame-coach Nick Saban, kampioenenmaker in het college football en tegenwoordig analist bij ESPN. In zijn 28 jaar als coach won hij zes national championships met Alabama en een met LSU, met een winstpercentage van ruim 80%. Toen hij in 2024 stopte, werd hij analist bij het wekelijkse programma College GameDay. Saban en zijn vrouw Terry zijn daarnaast altijd bezig geweest met liefdadigheidsprojecten in de staat Alabama.

programme.title: ESPN Film
programme.sub-title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
programme.desc: Op 14 maart 2025 schreef Steph Curry geschiedenis door als eerste NBA-speler ooit de grens van 4000 driepunters te doorbreken. In deze documentaire wordt het schot van de ster van Golden State Warriors benaderd als kunstvorm. Van het jongetje dat in North Carolina opgroeide als zoon van een NBA-speler, via zijn college-jaren bij Davidson en entree in de Draft van 2009, tot het moment van het record. In die 4000 rake driepunters schilderde artiest Curry zijn eigen portret.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster caused by mysterious arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles. However, Hunt and his colleagues are soon pushed to their limits thanks to a face from their past. Writer/director Christopher McQuarrie's sixth entry in the action thriller saga, starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Rebecca Ferguson.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt and his team are implicated in a bombing at the Kremlin, forcing the American president to declare them fugitives. The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula Patton.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: The team of secret agents faces being shut down when the head of the CIA convinces the US Senate that it is too dangerous. The operatives of the Impossible Mission Force become fugitives when they defy orders and plot to bring down a shadowy society of assassins. Spy thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Rebecca Ferguson and Simon Pegg.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster caused by mysterious arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles. However, Hunt and his colleagues are soon pushed to their limits thanks to a face from their past. Writer/director Christopher McQuarrie's sixth entry in the action thriller saga, starring Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Rebecca Ferguson.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is in exile with both halves of the 3D cruciform key that can unlock the source code of rogue AI creation, the Entity. Hunt returns to London to reunite with Luther Stickell, Benji Dunn and former thief Grace. The Entity's human henchman, Gabriel, is still on the loose, so Hunt bolsters his ranks with vengeful French assassin Paris and US intelligence agent Theo Degas. Action thriller, starring Tom Cruise, Hayley Atwell, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg and Esai Morales.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Cruise, Jon Voight and Ving Rhames.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible 2
programme.desc: Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Extreme sports star Xander Cage finds himself in trouble when his daredevil exploits land him behind bars. However, he is offered an intriguing escape route, courtesy of National Security Agent Augustus Gibbons - who thinks the adrenaline junkie is the perfect man to bring down a gang of international terrorists in Prague. Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: The American secretary of defence forms a covert military organisation with the intention of assassinating the president. A government spymaster is ready to foil the plot but, since his top agent is dead, he has to recruit an imprisoned soldier to help him. Action sequel, starring Ice Cube, Samuel L Jackson and Willem Dafoe.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: Undercover government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) rides into a small town, happening upon a saloon that's just been shot up. Wary of the newcomer, the sheriff (Earle Dwire) arrests Randy for the murders, but the saloon owner's niece, Sally Rogers (Alberta Vaughn), helps him escape because she knows he didn't do it. Randy then sets out to find the man behind the murders and is led to an evil mastermind named Marvin Black (George Hayes), who has been passing himself off as an innocent mute.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Yankee Fakir
programme.desc: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: The John Wayne Story: The Early Years
programme.desc: Profile of John Wayne's early years in the movie industry.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: Cash Cab
programme.desc: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host.

The contestant who gains full control over The Floor takes home a life-changing grand prize.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.sub-title: Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.sub-title: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: The Best Fish You're Not Eating
programme.desc: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
programme.desc: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: DuckTales
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck is back in this reboot of the late-'80s animated series. He gains guardianship of grandnephews Huey, Dewey and Louie when Donald Duck reluctantly takes them to McDuck Manor, the wonder of which enthralls the mischievous triplets. While living with their trillionaire relative, the boys learn long-held family secrets and unleash symbolic artifacts from Scrooge's past. The threesome's antics send the family on a number of adventures, which include Webby Vanderquack, the granddaughter of Scrooge's housekeeper, Mrs. Beakley. The show's animation style is inspired by the classic comic designs of animator Carl Barks.

programme.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir
programme.desc: Marinette seems to be a normal teenage girl -- she dreams of becoming a fashion designer, is a bit awkward and has a crush on a classmate. But she has a secret other teenagers don't have -- she lives a double life as a crime-fighting superhero known as Ladybug. She uses her superpowers to help protect her native Paris from supervillain Hawk Moth. She is assisted, reluctantly, by fellow hero Cat Noir, even though she insists she doesn't need him -- a stance she might not take if she knew his alter ego is her crush, Adrien. Together, Ladybug and Cat Noir help keep Paris safe from Hawk Moth and other villains.

programme.desc: Twins Dipper and Mabel Pines are sent to spend the summer with their great-uncle, Grunkle Stan, in the mysterious town of Gravity Falls, Ore. Grunkle Stan has the kids help him run The Mystery Shack, the tourist trap that he owns. The twins try to adapt to the weird surroundings but sense there is something strange about Gravity Falls and begin to unlock its secrets. When Dipper uncovers a cryptic journal that offers insight into the town's mysteries, he and Mabel use it and their enthusiastic desire to vanquish evil to battle the imminent mysteries that surround them.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.
